Now, a long time ago, some kids came from a place called Cuba. The grown-ups in charge of the playground decided to let those Cuban kids stay and play, because of some special rules they made a long time ago.

But kids coming from another place called Mexico, the grown-ups usually tell them they can’t stay and play on the playground right away—they have to go back home and try again later.
